messages:
Evan: Hi people-ops — I'm in Berlin on a work trip and my spouse (Maya) needs to see a doctor today for a bad allergic reaction. Our dependents were added during open enrollment but the digital ID card in the app only shows me. The clinic and pharmacy are asking for proof of dependent coverage to bill/dispense. Can you help urgently?

People Ops: Oh no, hope Maya is okay. We can generate a dependent verification letter and a temporary dependent ID. Quick Qs: can you upload Maya's passport photo, the dependent enrollment confirmation email (or marriage certificate if that was used), and the clinic appointment slip? We can email or fax the verification to the clinic.

Evan: Uploading now: maya_passport.jpg, dep_enroll_email.pdf, clinic_slip.jpg. Clinic wants an emailed verification from employer to release antihistamine injection and a short invoice to bill to insurer. Clinic email is info@berlin-allergie.de.

Claims Team: Checklist for dependent verification + expedited claim intake:
- Dependent passport or government ID photo
- Enrollment confirmation (email or benefits portal screenshot)
- Clinic invoice/appointment slip (photo ok)
- If provider bills directly, ask them to send an itemized invoice to claims@redwood.com with subject: "Dependent Direct Bill  Evan/Maya  Claim 1912345678"

People Ops: We can email a verification letter to info@berlin-allergie.de now. It will state Maya is covered as dependent effective 2026-01-01 (we redact policy number) and include our benefits verification phone +1-555-0199. ETA: within 90 minutes. Do you want us to CC you?

Evan: Yes please cc evan@redwood.com. Also quick Q: if clinic bills me up front, will I be reimbursed in EUR or USD?

Claims Team: Reimbursements are issued in USD. We convert using the FX rate on the date of service (XE.com) unless you provide a bank/card statement showing the exact converted USD amount. Upload receipts + card txn and we will process. For urgent processing, mark "Expedite: Dependent Emergency" in the portal notes.

Benefits Bot: Tip: you can create a temporary dependent digital card in the portal under "Dependent documents" — that generates a PDF you can print or show on phone. It speeds up pharmacy releases.

People Ops: Verification email sent to info@berlin-allergie.de and cc'd to you  message ID HR-191234-AUTO. We also created temp dependent ID (ID-191234-DEP) and uploaded PDF to your benefits folder. Clinic auto-replied they received it and asked for a scanned clinic invoice to bill Redwood directly.

Evan: Clinic sent invoice to claims@redwood.com. Thank you so much for the quick help. Maya's doing better after the shot.

Claims Team: Received invoice and marked claim as "Expedite - Dependent Emergency". Expect intake confirmation within 24-48 hours and faster adjudication priority. If the clinic requests a PO for direct billing, we'll escalate to Finance; otherwise we'll reimburse you after we adjudicate.

Maya Chen: Thank you everyone for the fast response  really appreciated.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: after travel, upload all clinical receipts and any pharmacy dispensing slips to the portal to help with quality monitoring and future dependent verification.
